summary: Research a question, independently check evidence and risks in parallel, then obtain human approval.

nodes.title: Research the question
nodes.description: Gather evidence, document sources, and distinguish established facts from assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: The question is answered with traceable evidence.
Assumptions and unanswered questions are documented.

nodes.title: Review evidence independently
nodes.description: Verify the research sources and whether the conclusions follow from the evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence has been independently checked and blocking findings resolved.

nodes.title: Review risks independently
nodes.description: Identify missing constraints, safety concerns, and uncertainty in the proposed conclusions.
acceptance_criteria: Material risks are recorded and blocking findings resolved.

nodes.title: Obtain explicit human approval
nodes.description: Ask a human to approve the research after both independent reviews finish.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized human explicitly approves the reviewed conclusions.
